version_history.note: Two fixes on the India-wine-market forecast bar chart, applied on top of the concurrent sitewide markup sync (v1.0.4, +1051 bytes). (1) The 2032 bar's top (y=68) collided with the subtitle (55.4px). (2) While rescaling, found the two bars weren't drawn to a consistent scale: at the original heights, $802.9M (4.11x $195.3M) was drawn only 3.26x as tall as the $195.3M bar, visually understating the forecast growth. Rescaled both bars to a single consistent linear scale (new 2032 bar top y=95, comfortably below the subtitle) so bar height now accurately reflects the value ratio; recomputed value-label positions to match. A git merge of this session's edit against the concurrent sitewide sync combined both changes cleanly (they touched different lines); republished the merged content since the first publish had been built off a stale pre-sync local copy.
